STI.why: Supplies central chemical supply systems (CCSS, 85.6% of H1 2026 sales) and wet/reflow process equipment to memory fabs; Samsung Electronics (45%) and SK Hynix (31%) are its main customers, so DRAM/HBM fab build-outs drive its orders.
STI.evidence: STI half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): major customers Samsung Electronics 45% and SK Hynix 31% of sales; supply contracts with SK Hynix (KRW 39,439,000 thousand, KRW 20,788,000 thousand, KRW 52,986,000 thousand) and Samsung Electronics (KRW 39,469,680,000).

players.product: Central chemical supply systems (CCSS) for fab front-end processes; fluxless lead-free vacuum reflow for flip-chip bumping

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 146,300,096,503 (H1 2025: KRW 171,268,511,769) and operating profit KRW 3,260,723,611 (H1 2025: KRW 10,625,267,572); the company says operating profit fell about 69% and net income rose about 72%; Q2 2026 revenue KRW 72,460,474,672 (Q2 2025: KRW 87,194,838,726) and Q2 operating profit KRW 2,896,079,741 (Q2 2025: KRW 5,384,766,891); H1 net income KRW 9,435,860,717 (H1 2025: KRW 5,497,283,853). By product: C.C.S.S. KRW 125,289,144 thousand (85.6%), Wet System KRW 9,912,323 thousand (6.8%)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 146,300,096,503; operating profit KRW 3,260,723,611

quarterly_data.signal: Products: C.C.S.S. (central chemical supply systems that deliver chemicals to semiconductor and display front-end tools) make up about 80-90% of sales; the company estimates its CCSS market share at 40% (Hanyang ENG 40%). It localized a fluxless lead-free vacuum reflow system for flip-chip bump formation, a market it says a US company monopolizes, and has won customers in China and Korea; FC-BGA substrate wet-process developers are on order and in production

Other customers and contracts: EXYTE 5% and STECO 2% of consolidated H1 2026 sales; a supply contract with Nova Tech Semiconductor (NTS, China) for power-semiconductor manufacturing equipment (KRW 97,838,398,692, 2025-12-05 to 2027-09-04) is in progress

Order backlog KRW 214,349,892 thousand at June 30, 2026 (cumulative orders KRW 868,159,874 thousand, delivered KRW 653,809,982 thousand); contract assets KRW 98,540,763,767 vs KRW 82,934,619,415 at end-2025

Capacity: average utilization 46.73% in H1 2026 (494 of 1,056 available hours) at Anseong/Yongin; H1 production capacity C.C.S.S. KRW 237,600,000 thousand and Wet System KRW 25,000,000 thousand; H1 production C.C.S.S. KRW 113,404,708 thousand and Wet System KRW 9,317,331 thousand
